important_semantics: This artifact contains human judgments only; it does not load or join the LLM adjudication.
The completed XLSX SHA256 is fixed and verified against the local pre-transfer hash.
All immutable evidence fields visible in the review workbook were checked against the frozen review-input TSV.
Human-versus-LLM comparison must occur only after this human-only release has been committed.
purpose: Freeze the completed human judgments for the 20-record Open Library target-identity audit before joining them to the frozen LLM judgments.
review_blinding_note: The review workbook itself withheld LLM labels, LLM confidence, pair counts, retrieval-risk classes, and retrieval impact fields. However, the reviewer had previously been exposed to row-level LLM results during the analysis discussion. Therefore this adjudication must not be described as a fully independent blinded human audit.
